description_en: Queries the hourly data of shared broadcasts in Qlixiang by paging
description_zh: 调用该接口分页查询千里传音中共享播报的小时数据
name: PageQuerySpeechBroadcastHour

parameters.help_en:
The share code of the corpus sharing task.

You can obtain the share code on the Shared Corpus Management page of the Qlixiang Speech Broadcast Service
parameters.help_zh:
语料分享任务的分享码。

您可在千里传音语音播报服务的分享语料管理页面，获取分享码
parameters.name: share_task_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 2000
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，默认值为10，最大不超过2,000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the PageToken value returned from the previous query.

For example, to query page n, pass in the PageToken value returned from the query of page n-1
parameters.help_zh:
下一页标识，首次查询无需传入。后续查询需使用的PageToken，要从上一次查询的返回结果中获取。

例如查询第n页时，传入查询第n-1页返回的PageToken值
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.help_en: The time to query. For example, 2020090919 indicates 19:00 on September 9, 2020
parameters.name: query_date_time_hour

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The result returned if the call is successful

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page

PageToken.description_en:
The token for the next page. You can pass this value in the next request to retrieve the next page of data.

If the PageToken value is empty, no more pages are available
PageToken.description_zh:
下一页标识。可在下次请求时传入，来获取下一页数据。

如果PageToken值为空，表示没有下一页数据

Total.description_en: The total number of data records

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
